nature: independent synthetic-tensor GPU microbenchmark; no validation completion times
method: least squares through origin over all 90 receiver samples using legacy billed bytes=(tokens+1)*524288; round to integer Gi-bits/s to match baseline
limitations: serial PyNccl SimpleBuffer wall time includes lookup and producer wait
does not include destination KV installation or full service frontend
concurrent contention and CPU/GPU overlap not captured
legacy billed bytes are a comparison cost basis, not physical tensor bytes
no accuracy or calibration acceptance claim
